div.div:
AI Assistant Observability
Normalized telemetry for AI tool usage.
Version-aware metrics. Privacy-first.
● AgentMetricEvent schema
● Skill activation + cost tracking
● Version enrichment via Forge
● Push to company’s own backend
(DataDog, Grafana, OTLP, webhook)
● Crucible never sees the data
● Closed loop: measure → optimize
